rooms.name: A large clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small clearing in a field. As you look
around you see you are in a enormous valley, all around you are
large leafy plants and trees. There is some large footprints
in the ground here, looks like they were made from some
gigantic beast.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are in the northern end of the clearing birds and sound of
other animals are all round you. The jungle is just before
you, it is quite dark and mysterious. There is some bones a
flesh scattered around here.

rooms.name: Edge of the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have just entered the outer rim of the jungle, there is
many strange plants and little rodents scurring around as you
enter. This jungle is quite dark, except for some rays of
sinlight poking through the canopy. You think you see some
large outlines in the distance, they almost look like they are
moving.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You are now fairly deep into the jungle, there is strange
sounds comeing from all over the place it seems. You are able
to make out the outlines, they look like giant beasts of some
sort. There is dense foliage and lots of leaves and broken sticks
on the ground here making it difficult to walk.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You follow what seems to be a path, however you have no idea
hwere it leady, except into darkness. You can hear what sounds
like twigs snapping, and some of the tree's around here look as
if some giant beast has beeing grazing on them. There is also
large indentations in the ground here.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the eastern edge of the clearing, the jungle is just
before you, you hear strange sounds comeing from it. There is some large ferns
and other plantlife around here, as you bend down to examine a shrub a small
lizard scurries out from under it, scaring the wits out of you.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have just entered the dark jungle, strange vines and webs lash you in the
face, making it difficult to walk through. There is all sorta of plantlife
htat you have never seen before, and you notice some large footprints in the
ground here, perhaps made by some gigantic beast.

rooms.name: In the jungle
rooms.desc:
You have entered deeper into the jungle, not much light passes throught the
dense canopy far above you. The tree are covered with dense vines and ivy,
making them slick and slimey. An occasional ray of sunlight passes through the
treetops, helping calm your senses.

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the southern edge of a clearing, you can see the valley
extends far in all directions. You can catch glimses of snowcapped mountains
in the distance. The jungle begins to the south and is spooky and creepy,
you are beginning to wonder if this is a dream...

rooms.name: Edge of a clearing
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the western edge of a large clearing, the dense jingle
is just to your west. There is some parge leafy plants and tall tree, almost
like a rainforest. You see that some of the plants are here have been uprooted
and the leave have been eaten off, you wonder what kind of animal did it.

rooms.name: Edge of the jungle
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the edge of the jungle, and a strange jungle at that. It
almost seems alien, you don't reckonize any of the oversized ferns and other
plantlife that grows within it. You wonder what kind of animals would live in
such a place.

rooms.name: Swank's special room
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a very special room, the only thing here is a very large
bookah type bong in the center of the room.
